input_units.initial_C: degree C; explicitly permitted initial lubricant measurement

timing_contract: Current/past housing, ambient, speed/friction only; first lubricant calibration, no later TL.
calibration: Original TL(0) calibration, no later lubricant measurement.

reference.equation: Two parallel stable states H_tau and S_tau use previous-sample exponential recurrence. yhat = H_fast + gamma_fast S_fast + gamma_slow S_slow + c(H_slow-H_fast), with H_tau(0)=TL0, S_tau(0)=0 and c in[0,1].

compact_candidate.equation: Two parallel stable states H_tau and S_tau use previous-sample exponential recurrence. yhat = H_fast + gamma_fast S_fast + gamma_slow S_slow + c(H_slow-H_fast), with H_tau(0)=TL0, S_tau(0)=0 and c in[0,1].

housing.equation: yhat = offset + sum beta_j phi_j(inputs), with exact frozen terms/clocks in rules.json and run.py::design; clipping only for photovoltaic energy. Legacy model has exact original runtime/state.

uncertainty_policy.reason: Shared source system/people/materials, temporal dependence or small reserved-group counts do not justify precise population-level confidence. Group effects are descriptive; no row bootstrap.

scope_limits: Five identification runs and eight source validation runs in one gearbox. Initial calibration and measured housing/friction signals are required; no unseen gearbox or sensorless temperature claim.

exposure.historical_record: ALL original confirmation exposed; no fresh confirmation; diagnostics opened only after candidate/stopping freeze; all future evaluations are retrospective

historical_metric_corrections: F1 uses2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); zero on nonempty total failure. Historical reports unchanged.
